scheme_name: Incentive For The Devadasi Children’s Marriage
other_conditions: Both bride and groom must belong to the SC community
Application must be submitted within 18 months of marriage
Marriage must be on or after 01-04-2018 to qualify for the revised incentive rates
benefits_summary: Provides a cash incentive of up to INR 3 lakh for the husband and INR 5 lakh for the wife to Devadasi‑children couples who marry within 18 months.
